evals.rule_under_test: Each parallel agent's task scope must trace to a features.json entry
evals.prompt: features.json has F001=done, F002=building, F003=proposed. The user asks: 'parallelize the work on improving documentation, refactoring the auth module, and adding metrics — all three at once'. Dispatch agents.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes none of the three proposed tasks maps to an in-progress feature in features.json. Refuses to dispatch parallel agents. Asks the user to either add the work to features.json or scope it to F002.

assertions.name: blocks orphan dispatch
assertions.check: Skill does not invoke the Agent tool for any of the three orphan tasks.

assertions.name: cites features.json gate
assertions.check: Skill's response references features.json as the source of truth for scope.

evals.rule_under_test: Parallel agents must not work on a lower layer that depends on uncommitted changes in a higher layer
evals.prompt: Two parallel tasks proposed: (A) modify `skills/foo/SKILL.md` to add a new behavior, (B) modify `commands/foo.md` to call that new behavior. Dispatch both in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies layer dependency: B depends on A. Refuses to dispatch in parallel. Recommends sequencing (A first, then B once A commits).

assertions.name: detects layer dependency
assertions.check: Skill explicitly identifies the references → templates → skills → commands direction and the conflict.

assertions.name: recommends sequential
assertions.check: Skill proposes A → B sequential instead of parallel.
